method: Codex computer use in real Chrome; native file chooser and visible product controls. DOM/read-only browser inspection and captured console logs.
observations: Local search progress and completion; cancellation left drawing and original project unchanged.
Invalid crossing keyboard polygon rejected and dirty draft blocked Search.
Seven-vertex custom keyboard loop accepted; search showed RMS1.291mm and maximum sampled gap3.035mm; Build created four connected native parts and four revolute joints.

Saved actual project, returned to original Boolean project without loss, reopened downloaded four-bar file through native Chrome chooser, refreshed and recovered all four parts/joints and original drawing coordinates.
Quarter-speed Run, Pause at1.10s, camera orbit, Resume, completion at6.00s and Reset to0s with cleared measurements observed.
Manual crank material change to Steel disabled original path comparison; saved fixture reopened to restore canonical design.
Actual STL and STEP downloads completed from reopened generated model; independent exported-file measurements are in export-check.json.

60mm Offset tracer preset search completed with displayed RMS0.001mm and largest sampled gap0.003mm, native Build succeeded, actual motion completed. Run again began a new cycle; Reset demo restored0s and original parameters.
coverageLimits: No claim that all freehand pointer shapes were exercised in real Chrome. Curved closed freehand input is covered by seven compiled-component handler tests; the available browser drag primitive moves in a straight line.
Displayed three-decimal0.000mm readings are rounded, not exact zero. Independent raw numerical limits are in four-bar-physics-results.json.
Console capture is bounded to the tool-provided log history. No claim that the native DevTools window was manually inspected.
Public Replit route was not republished or verified in this stage.
